turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery? Let's start with your pain. On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate the pain in your left knee right now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Eh, maybe around 3 or 4? It's sore, but the numbness from the block is still there, so it's not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Any nausea or vomiting since waking up? Sometimes the anesthesia can make people feel queasy.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No nausea, thank goodness. But my nose feels a bit stuffy, like it's blocked up. Is that normal?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That could be from the allergic rhinitis. We'll keep an eye on it, but it's not uncommon after anesthesia. Breathing comfortable otherwise?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, breathing's fine. No tightness or anything. Just the nose thing.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any recollection of the operating room or waking up? Sometimes patients remember bits and pieces.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, nothing at all. One minute I was talking to the anesthetist, next thing I know, I'm here. Like a magic trick!

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Glad to hear it was smooth. Any other concerns or questions before we get you mobilizing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that's all. Thanks for checking on me, doc.
